Reload Prep Prepper

    Prep Prepper

    Loading your list…

    To do this prep

        Tick when done. Click ✕ if something isn't really a task; it won't come back.

        Need to know

          Announcements and newsletters land here instead of your to-dos. The one-line gists come from the Gemini prompt below. Click "Got it" to clear one.

          Brain dump

          Deadlines it understands: today, tomorrow, Friday, by Thu, 10/31, Oct 31. Add "5 min" for a time estimate.

          From Gemini

          Gemini reads your email and Google Chat the way a person would: it finds the tasks the scanner misses and boils each announcement down to one line. Copy the prompt, paste it into a new chat at gemini.google.com, then paste Gemini's whole answer below.

          Show the prompt 
          Use @Gmail, @Google Chat, and @Google Drive. Look at the last 24 hours (go back to Friday if today is Monday): my inbox, my Google Chat direct messages and spaces, and the files shared with me. Chat moves fast, so read every space, not just the ones where I'm mentioned. Skip lesson planning and grading. Don't include student names.

1. Find everything that asks me to do something: reply, fill out, sign, submit, RSVP, attend, cover, make copies, read and acknowledge, or meet a deadline. That includes asks buried in chat threads. Write one line per task:
TASK | what to do | YYYY-MM-DD or none | estimated minutes | where it came from

2. For every announcement, newsletter, all-staff email, or chat update that changes something for me (schedules, dates, procedures, anything affecting my classroom), write one line:
KNOW | the email's exact subject, or "Chat: " plus the space or person's name | one-sentence gist

Combine repeat chat messages about the same thing into one line. Reply ONLY with those lines, with no headings or other text.

Example:
TASK | Return field trip roster to front office | 2026-10-30 | 5 | Email from Ms. Lopez
TASK | Tell Mr. Diaz if you can cover 3rd period Thursday | 2026-11-05 | 2 | Chat from Mr. Diaz
KNOW | Weekly Bulletin Oct 27 | Picture day moved to Nov 4, and Friday is early dismissal at 1:30.
KNOW | Chat: 6th Grade Team | Team meeting moved to Wednesday at 3:15 in room 204.
